title.en: The Theoretical Structure of Machine Learning

description.zh-CN: 一份连续的中文理论课件，依次介绍机器学习定义、多变量线性回归、梯度下降、矩阵运算、逻辑回归、神经网络、BP 算法、学习曲线，以及支持向量机与核函数。以公式推导和概念联系组织讲解。
description.en: One continuous theoretical presentation in Chinese covering the definition of machine learning, multivariate linear regression, gradient descent, matrix operations, logistic regression, neural networks, backpropagation, learning curves, and support vector machines with kernels, in that order.

summary.zh-CN: 任务、经验与评价标准；输入、标签、参数和假设空间。
summary.en: Tasks, experience and performance; inputs, targets, parameters and hypothesis spaces.

summary.zh-CN: 多个特征的预测函数、平方误差 Cost Function 及偏导。
summary.en: Prediction with multiple features, the squared-error cost and partial derivatives.

summary.zh-CN: 负梯度方向、学习率、同时更新及线性回归的更新公式。
summary.en: Negative gradients, learning rates, simultaneous updates and regression update equations.

summary.zh-CN: 内积、矩阵乘法、转置、逐元素运算与批量求和。
summary.en: Inner products, matrix multiplication, transpose, elementwise operations and batch reductions.

summary.zh-CN: sigmoid 模型、交叉熵 Cost Function 及梯度下降函数。
summary.en: The sigmoid model, cross-entropy cost and gradient descent equations.

summary.zh-CN: 多层前向传播、非线性激活与可学习表示。
summary.en: Multilayer forward propagation, nonlinear activations and learned representations.

summary.zh-CN: 链式法则、局部梯度、逐层递推与参数共享。
summary.en: The chain rule, local gradients, layerwise recurrence and shared parameters.

summary.zh-CN: 训练规模与误差、偏差和方差、正则化与独立评价。
summary.en: Training size and errors, bias and variance, regularization and independent evaluation.

summary.zh-CN: 间隔、hinge loss、核技巧、半正定性与 SVM 对偶。
summary.en: Margins, hinge loss, the kernel trick, positive semidefiniteness and the SVM dual.

subtitle.zh-CN: 机器学习基础 · 反向传播 · 核方法
subtitle.en: Machine Learning Foundations · Backpropagation · Kernel Methods
